page_observations.observation: Page 1 title: RESOLUTION 98-14 ESTABLISHING A RIGHT TO RANCH AND FARM POLICY. Recitals name the Board of County Commissioners of Custer County, Colorado (Board), ranching/farming, rural growth, conflicts and protection of legal and non-negligent agriculture; aspirations (a)–(c) continue onto page2.

Page 2 begins aspiration(d). Recitals cite Section29-20-104 with printed Colorado Revised Statues (sic); Article3.5, Title35; and Section35-3.5-102(1). One-year nuisance recital includes non-nuisance-at-start, non-negligence and no-change/substantial-increase-resulting-in-nuisance qualifications. No execution/date block appears.

Page 3 begins NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the Board of County Commissioners of Custer County. Numbered sections1 Policy Statement,2 Public Education and Information Campaign,3 Property owner notification. Policy protection is qualified by legal and non-negligent operation; references A Guide to Rural Living in Custer County. Property notifications continue next page.

Page 4 has property-notification subitems(a)–(d): mailing with1998 tax-year notices; added residential lots; building/zoning new-construction permits in unincorporated Custer County; voluntary broker disclosure. Printed real properly (sic) appears in(a). File ends after(d), with no visible signatures, attestation, vote or calendar adoption/effective date. There are no blank signature blocks to interpret as uncompleted. Resolution98-14 and1998 tax year do not alone establish execution or legal currentness.
